**STEP 3 - Items:** Whole almonds only, about 30 pieces. No oil or sauce is visible.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Piled whole nuts have a bulk density of about 0.55 g/ml, so 59 ml × 0.55 ≈ 32 g. Counting about 30 almonds at roughly 1.2 g each gives about 36 g, so I take about 35 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Almonds are about 579 kcal per 100 g, so 35 g × 5.79 ≈ 203 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 30 almonds at roughly 6–7 kcal each gives around 200 kcal, which fits a small handful in a bowl.
